Detailed Description

template<class OwnerType = void>
class GenericEventBase< OwnerType >

A generic event class with an owner.

This may be used to create a generic event for use with a variety of event-based UGen classes. Some flexibility is lost using this rather than a specialised version since this generic event cannot acces the UGenInternal to modify its behavious (e.g., changing the nextTime parameter in the case of the Spawn UGen).

See also:
GenericEventBase<void>, MixFill, Spawn, TSpawn, XFadeTexture, OverlapTexture, TrigXFade, VoicerBase, Voicer

template<class OwnerType = void>
UGen GenericEventBase< OwnerType >::spawnEvent ( VoicerBaseUGenInternal &  spawn,
const int  eventCount,
const int  midiChannel,
const int  midiNote,
const int  velocity 
) [inline, virtual]

You must implement this virtual function in your subclass.

The parent UGen calls this function each time it needs a new event instance.

Parameters:
spawn Allows acces to the internal UGen so that its behaviour can be modified (see Spawn for an example)
eventCount The index of the event instance starting at 0 for the first event.
Returns:
The UGen graph for this event instance.
Parameters:
midiChannel The MIDI channel of the calling MIDI note on event.
midiNote The MIDI note number of the calling MIDI note on event.
velocity The velocity of the calling MIDI note event. This should in the range 1-127 since velocity values of 0 should have been filtered out to turn already sounding notes off (if the note number matched the note number of an already sounding note).
